claims.statement: The Mauryan dynasty brought much of the Indian subcontinent under one ruling house. Chandragupta founded it, followed by Bindusara and Ashoka. Its capital was Pataliputra. The connections here follow the rulers, their dealings with Alexander’s successors and the surviving evidence of Ashoka’s reign.
The Mauryan Empire: 321 BCE to 185 BCE. Approximate dynastic chronology follows the Met’s main text, 321–185 BCE; its heading uses 323. No fixed territorial border is implied.
